_doc: Every owner-only step in docs/ops/OWNER-STEPS.md as an ordered chain: detect, attempt each autonomous route, fall back, and only then open ONE card. A route of kind credential runs the credential ladder; handler runs foundation/handlers.py. `completes` true means success finishes the step. No route may get past a permission check, impersonate the owner or handle a secret value.

steps.title: Legal entity and IP assignment
steps.reason: a legal act with the owner's identity and money

card.what: Choose and register the owning entity and assign the IP to it
card.why: a legal act with the owner's identity and money
card.default: projects run in the owner's own name; entity-only programmes stay deferred
card.probe: entity name set in LICENSE and applicant.json
